summary.en: An offline-first focus session planner for students, freelancers, and knowledge workers. Plan focused work sessions, track your time, capture distractions, and review patterns—all locally, without requiring an account or internet connection. Coordinate focus sessions with others
summary.ar: An offline-first focus session planner for students, freelancers, and knowledge workers. Plan focused work sessions, track your time, capture distractions, and review patterns—all locally, without requiring an account or internet connection. Coordinate focus sessions with others

features.en: Session Templates: Create reusable focus session templates (e.g., "Deep Work 90min", "Quick Focus 25min")
features.ar: Session Templates: Create reusable focus session templates (e.g., "Deep Work 90min", "Quick Focus 25min")

features.en: Active Timer: Start sessions with a countdown timer, pause/resume, and track elapsed time
features.ar: Active Timer: Start sessions with a countdown timer, pause/resume, and track elapsed time

features.en: Distraction Capture: Log distractions during sessions (phone, email, social media, thoughts, other)
features.ar: Distraction Capture: Log distractions during sessions (phone, email, social media, thoughts, other)

features.en: Task Intention & Outcome: Record what you're focusing on and what you accomplished
features.ar: Task Intention & Outcome: Record what you're focusing on and what you accomplished

features.en: Session History: View all completed sessions with details, outcomes, and distraction counts
features.ar: Session History: View all completed sessions with details, outcomes, and distraction counts

features.en: Daily Review: Reflect on your focus day with session stats and personal notes
features.ar: Daily Review: Reflect on your focus day with session stats and personal notes

features.en: Arabic and RTL UI: Switch the interface language and automatically mirror document direction for Arabic
features.ar: واجهة عربية واتجاه RTL: بدّل لغة الواجهة وتتحول تلقائيًا إلى اتجاه RTL عند اختيار العربية

features.en: Quick Start Presets: Prefill 15-minute sprint, 25-minute focus, and 50-minute deep-work sessions
features.ar: بدايات سريعة: املأ إعدادات جلسات اندفاعة 15 دقيقة وتركيز 25 دقيقة وعمل عميق 50 دقيقة مسبقًا

features.en: Focus Session Preferences: Optionally keep the screen awake, play a soft completion chime, use haptics, and receive personal end notifications
features.ar: تفضيلات جلسة التركيز: أبقِ الشاشة مضاءة اختياريًا وشغّل نغمة هادئة أو اهتزازًا واستقبل إشعارًا عند انتهاء الجلسة الشخصية

features.en: 30-Day Activity Review: View completed focus time by local calendar day without streaks or gamification
features.ar: مراجعة نشاط 30 يومًا: اعرض وقت التركيز المكتمل حسب اليوم المحلي دون سلاسل أو عناصر تحفيز لعبية

features.en: Mobile Navigation: Access session actions and primary destinations from a fixed bottom navigation bar
features.ar: Mobile Navigation: Access session actions and primary destinations from a fixed bottom navigation bar
